'''MAD Team''' (abbreviated MAD) was a professional esports based in [[:Category:Taiwan|Taiwan]].

'''MAD Team''' disbanded on December 18, 2019 after not being selected for the [[PCS/2020/Spring|PCS 2020]] season. <ref name="MAD disband">{{cite web |url=https://www.facebook.com/MadTeam.club/posts/740026319840768 |title=MAD Team League of Legends Announcement |date=2019-12-18 |author='''MAD Team'''|language={{Flag|tw}}}}</ref>
